# Crypto Inheritance Platform (CIP)

> Open-source, zero-knowledge, non-custodial crypto inheritance protocol providing verifiable estate continuity without custodial risk.

The Crypto Inheritance Platform (CIP) guarantees sovereign transfer of Bitcoin, Ethereum, and digital estate instructions to heirs. It eliminates single points of failure by combining air-gapped Verifiable Shamir Secret Sharing (VSSS), hardware FIDO2 passkeys, decentralized multi-clock time anchors, and an isolated AWS Nitro Enclave release signer.

## Core Specifications

- [Protocol Specification](https://cip.network/protocol): Formal mathematical foundation including 2-of-2 Shamir secret sharing over GF(256), BLAKE2b commitment generation, and X25519 sealed boxes.
- [Security Architecture & Threat Model](https://cip.network/security): Defense against rogue cloud operators, state-level Lazarus APT adversaries, compromised heirs, and sybil clock warping.
- [Offline CLI Tooling](https://cip.network/cli): Air-gapped command-line tool `cip` for cold-tier vault initialization, seed phrase encryption, and deterministic package compilation.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://cip.network/faq): High-intent answers regarding estate planning, tax implications, seed phrase safety, and dead man switch mechanics.
- [Terms of Service](https://cip.network/terms): Legal boundaries, non-custodial software disclaimer, and open-source licensing.
- [Privacy Policy](https://cip.network/privacy): Zero-knowledge data handling, blind HMAC email indexing, and transient session handling.

## Architecture & ADR Invariants

- [ADR-0001: Two-Tier Secret Separation](https://cip.network/protocol#adr-0001): Web and API tiers never process, accept, or store unencrypted seed phrases or threshold shares.
- [ADR-0002: Zero Custom Cryptography](https://cip.network/protocol#adr-0002): Strictly vetted primitives (libsodium-wrappers-sumo, @noble/hashes, XChaCha20-Poly1305).
- [ADR-0003: Passkeys Exclusively](https://cip.network/protocol#adr-0003): WebAuthn FIDO2 resident keys required for owner and heir authentication. Email is only an alert channel.
- [ADR-0004: Isolated Enclave Release](https://cip.network/protocol#adr-0004): Escrow shares decrypted strictly within an isolated AWS Nitro Enclave after 30-day unchallenged claims.

## Verification & Open Source

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/aethel-network/crypto-inheritance-platform): MIT-licensed source code, reproducible Docker builds, and automated KAT test suites.
- [Reproducible Bundle Verification](https://cip.network/cli#bundle-verification): Deterministic build hashing allowing users to audit hosted web bundles against git tags.
- [Bug Bounty Program](https://cip.network/security#bug-bounty): Up to $250,000 for critical zero-knowledge or enclave isolation bypass vulnerabilities.
